folderSettings.folderTitle: Dialog or tab title for a folder. {{name}} is the folder name.
folderSettings.collectionTitle: Title of the settings of the collection (top-level folder) the current request belongs to.
folderSettings.allCollectionsTitle: Title of the settings that apply to every collection in the app.
folderSettings.collectionName: Name of the scope shown in the inheritance hint. Singular noun.
folderSettings.allCollectionsName: Name of the scope that covers every collection. Short.
folderSettings.tabs.script: Tab label for pre-request and post-response scripts.
folderSettings.tabs.tests: Tab label for checks (assertions) that run after each response.
folderSettings.tabs.docs: Tab label for documentation text. Short.
folderSettings.more: Label of the overflow menu button when not all tabs fit.
folderSettings.headerLabel: Label of one header row. Singular.
folderSettings.varsInvalid: Error shown when the variables text is not a JSON object.
folderSettings.preScript: Heading above the script that runs before the request is sent.
folderSettings.postScript: Heading above the script that runs after the response arrives.
folderSettings.timeLimit: Label of a number field; (s) means seconds.
folderSettings.inherit: Option meaning a request uses the auth of its folder or collection.
folderSettings.noAuth: Option meaning no authentication is sent.
folderSettings.inheritsFrom: {{name}} is the folder or collection that provides the setting.
folderSettings.inheritsSchemeFrom: {{name}} is the folder or collection, {{scheme}} is an auth type such as Bearer or Basic.
folderSettings.inheritedHeaders: Summary of headers that come from outer folders. {{count}} is a number.
folderSettings.inheritedTitle: Heading of the list of headers a request receives from its folders.
folderSettings.authorizationValue: Explains where an inherited Authorization header comes from. {{source}} is a folder or collection name.
folderSettings.openAuthTab: Short link label that opens the Auth tab of the request.
folderSettings.openSource: Tooltip of a link. {{name}} is a folder or collection name.
folderSettings.headerStates.replaced: Badge on an inherited header that a request overrides.
folderSettings.headerStates.off: Badge on an inherited header that is switched off.
folderSettings.menuSettings: Context menu item that opens the settings of a folder.
folderSettings.collectionMenu: Context menu item that opens the settings of a collection.
folderSettings.tabs.auth: Tab name: authentication settings. Short for authentication.
